action_items: Review the next.config.mjs change: I added `experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins` (containing the preview hostnames used by the ingress/proxy: *.preview.emergentagent.com and *.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud plus localhost:3000) and `allowedDevOrigins`. Without this, ALL Server Actions (invite_member, grant_role, revoke_role, set_member_status, provision_tenant, sign-out redirect flows that rely on server actions) failed in the preview with 'Invalid Server Actions request.' because Next.js rejects the request when x-forwarded-host != origin. Consider generalising with wildcards or env-driven config for production builds.
Optional polish: expose [data-testid=login-email-input]/[login-password-input]/[login-submit-button] on /login (previous iteration noted this too).
Optional polish: give the Suspender menuitem its own data-testid (currently only Desligar has disable-teste@exemplo.com); Editar papéis menuitem also lacks a data-testid.
critical_code_review_comments: Server Actions were completely broken in the preview environment due to missing serverActions.allowedOrigins in next.config.mjs. This is a hard blocker for a schema-write-heavy feature set (invite/grant/revoke/status/provision). Ship this config with the app.
list_members returns role NAMES (e.g. 'Dono') and correctly shows the Dono badge; the disable-self guard is implemented properly (Suspender + Desligar both aria-disabled for the current user).
Wizard close correctly distinguishes 'has company' (returns to /) from 'no company' (would sign out) per spec.
No horizontal overflow at 390px on / or /pessoas; mobile drawer works.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Next.js 15 App Router on port 3000 via supervisor; preview URL https://company-invite.preview.emergentagent.com . IMPORTANT: I added `experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins` + `allowedDevOrigins` to /app/frontend/next.config.mjs so that Server Actions work through the Cloudflare ingress (x-forwarded-host vs origin mismatch). If the preview hostname changes, update those arrays. All Pessoas/Access flows depend on this. Data-testids observed: home-greeting, company-static, user-menu-trigger, header-user-email, sign-out-button, sidebar-nav, nav-inicio/ap/ar/bank/reconcile/partners/items/cashflow/pessoas/assistente, em-breve-title, member-row-<email>, member-actions-<email>, disable-<email>, view-as-<email>, invite-open-button, invite-dialog, invite-email-input, invite-role-select, invite-submit-button, edit-roles-dialog, role-checkbox-<key>, viewas-nav-*, wizard-close-button, wizard-submit-button, mobile-menu-button, mobile-nav. Radix checkboxes expose state via data-state (checked/unchecked) rather than aria-checked. list_members returns Portuguese role names.
rca of the issue: Symptom: invite/grant/revoke/status server actions returned HTTP 500 'Invalid Server Actions request.' and crashed the /pessoas route (runtime error at <MembersManager>). Cause (from frontend supervisor log): Next.js 15 aborts forwarded Server Action requests when the `x-forwarded-host` header does not equal the `origin` header, unless the origin is listed in `experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins`. The Cloudflare ingress in this preview rewrites host to 663da870-...preview.emergentagent.com while the browser origin is 663da870-...cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud. Fix: added both hostnames (and erp-financeiro-10.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud + localhost:3000) to `experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins`, and added `allowedDevOrigins` to silence the related dev warning. After restart, invite_member succeeded and the toast 'Convite enviado.' appeared as specified.
